title: Station
description: A deadair station somebody runs and wants people to tune in to. One file per station, named for its slug.

name.description: What the station calls itself on air.

url.description: The station's public address, https and with no trailing slash. The directory checks whether it is on air by reading <url>/api/nowplaying, which every station answers without a sign-in.

location.description: Where it broadcasts from, as loosely as you like: a city, a region, a country.

genres.description: What it mostly plays. Up to five.

language.description: The language the presenter speaks, as a BCP 47 tag such as en, en-GB or fr.

description.description: A few sentences about the station, in your own words.
